sn56.51:1.1: Atha kho Bhagavā parittam nakhasikhāyam paṃsum āropetvā bhikkhū āmantesi ||
sn56.51:1.3: katamaṃ nu kho bahutaram yo vāyam mayā paritto nakhasikhāyam paṃsu āropito || ayaṃ vā mahāpathavī ti || ||
sn56.51:1.4: Etad eva bhante bahutaram yad idam mahāpathavī || appamattako yam Bhagavatā paritto nakhasikhāyam paṃsu āropito
sn56.51:1.5: saṅkham pi na upeti upanidham pi na upeti kalabhāgam pi na upeti || mahāpathavī upanidhāya Bhagavatā paritto nakhasikhāyam paṃsu āropito ti || || 3.
sn56.51:1.6: Evam eva kho bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa abhisametāvino etad eva bahutaraṃ dukkham || pe ||
sn56.51:1.8: yo Idaṃ dakkhanti yathābhūtam pajānāti || la [pe] || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāmini patipadā ti yathābhūtam pajānā ti || || 4.
sn56.51:2.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave Idam dukkhanti yogo karaṇīyo || la-pe || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti || yogo karaṇīyo
